title: Jet Lag Recovery Planner
description: Beat jet lag with a day-by-day plan: zones crossed and travel direction give your recovery timeline, light-exposure schedule and sleep-shift tips.
howto: Enter how many time zones you cross and whether you fly east or west.
Enter your arrival date (and usual bedtime).
Press Plan to get your estimated recovery days and a daily adjustment schedule.
Follow the light-exposure and sleep tips day by day.

faqs.a: Rule of thumb from sleep research: about 1 day per time zone traveling west, about 1.5 days per zone traveling east (eastward is harder). The plan covers that whole window.
Westward travel lengthens your day, which the body clock adapts to easily. Eastward travel shortens the day, forcing your clock to advance — physiologically harder.
Timed bright-light exposure, shifting sleep 1 hour per day before/after travel, and short strategic naps. The daily schedule below times these for your direction.
